card.name: Inside uncommon surnames
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle or end of rare, foreign-looking surnames split into several parts, such as Sjögren, Merzenich or Berditsch. It fires on the part just before the name is complete.

modes.label: Surname endings
modes.description: Final or near-final piece of a rare surname of a researcher or executive.
modes.example: Gary Holt<<zer>>, Hines’ global sustainability officer.

modes.label: Eponym spelling
modes.description: Piece inside a surname used in a disease or anatomy name.

card.plain: It marks the middle of an unusual person's surname that the model is reading in pieces.
